_comment: Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry suppresses one advisory for one package, only until `expires`. Delete an entry as soon as a patched version exists. Keep entries rare: this is for advisories with no fix, not for postponing a bump.

advisories.reason: node-forge <= 1.4.0, no patched version. The flaw is in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature VERIFICATION (extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements accepted). taqwright uses node-forge only in src/network/ca.ts, to GENERATE a local CA and leaf certificates for network capture (pki.rsa.generateKeyPair, createCertificate, PEM conversion); it never verifies a signature with it, so the vulnerable path is not reached. Expiry is 30 days from when the advisory began failing CI (2 Oct 2026). Remove when node-forge ships a fix; if none by then, replace node-forge in src/network/ca.ts rather than extend.
